name: Overgrown Robot Tea Garden
description: A peaceful tea garden where gentle vintage robots are covered in moss and flowers, pouring tea for butterflies.
prompt: A single heartwarming scene of a tranquil tea garden overgrown with moss, ferns, and wildflowers. Three gentle vintage robots with rounded metal bodies and glowing eyes sit among giant teacups, one pouring steaming tea from a silver kettle. Butterflies and small birds gather. Soft morning light, dew, rusty copper and emerald green palette, painterly sci-fi nostalgia, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Even machines deserve a quiet cup of tea. What would you ask this mossy robot gardener?
